description: LocalAI is the open-source AI engine. Run any model - LLMs, vision, voice, image, video - on any hardware. No GPU required.

latest_release.name: v4.12.1
latest_release.body:
Patch release v4.12.1. Security fix only.

**Security**

- Hardened the external URL policy for user-supplied URLs (chat vision image/audio/video URLs, image and audio endpoints). Redirect targets are now validated on every hop, 100.64.0.0/10 and 0.0.0.0/8 are treated as non-public, and the connection goes to the address that was validated. See #12853. Credits to @spicysharkco for the discovery.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI/compare/v4.12.0...v4.12.1

detail.readme:
Documentation | Quick start | Models | Discord | FAQ | Blog

**LocalAI** is your own AI, on your own hardware, ready to work for you. It is open source. Chat with open models, run agents that use your files, and work on documents with your team. It also does voice, images, video and more. No GPU required. - **Agents, documents and a team**: chats and saved agents that use tools, [MCP](https://localai.io/docs/features/mcp/) servers, files, collections and skills. Users, roles, quotas and shared folders for a team (development builds). - **Add-ons**: an admin installs add-ons from a library: Office, Sandbox, Tables, chat apps (Telegram, Slack, Discord), mail, calendar and more (development builds). - **Every kind of model, one API**: text, vision, voice, images, video and embeddings, in the OpenAI, Anthropic and ElevenLabs formats, with more than 80 backends. Each backend is its own image, pulled only when a model needs it. - **Your hardware**: NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Apple Silicon, Vulkan, NVIDIA Jetson or CPU only. The server, the models and your files stay on your own machines. ![LocalAI is a small core with an API, chats and agents, files, collections, team sharing, a model gallery and an MCP client and server for agent tools. Backends such as llama.cpp, vLLM, MLX and whisper.cpp plug in on one side, add-ons such as Office, Sandbox, Tables and chat apps on the other. It runs on CPU, NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Apple Silicon and Vulkan.](docs/static/images/diagrams/composable-core.png) Created by [Ettore Di Giacinto](https://github.com/mudler) and maintained by the [LocalAI team](#team). ## Quick start **Script** (Linux, and macOS on Apple Silicon): it downloads the release binary for your machine and checks it against the release checksums. ```bash curl -sSL https://localai.io/install.sh | sh local-ai run qwen3-4b ``` **Container** (Docker, podman, ...): ```bash docker run -ti --name local-ai -p 8080:8080 localai/localai:latest ``` **Desktop app**: the launcher installs and updates the server for you, on Linux (AppImage) and macOS (DMG). Download `LocalAI.dmg` or the AppImage from the [releases page](https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI/releases) and see the [desktop app guide](https://localai.io/docs/start/install/desktop/). The script, the app and the latest container image give version 4.12.1. The add-ons, Office, Sandbox and team features described below need a development build or a newer release. Then open `http://localhost:8080`. To restart an existing container, use `docker start -i local-ai`. More ways to install: [Install LocalAI](https://localai.io/docs/start/install/).
GPU images (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Vulkan) ```bash # NVIDIA, CUDA 13 docker run -ti --name local-ai -p 8080:8080 --gpus all localai/localai:latest-gpu-nvidia-cuda-13 # NVIDIA, CUDA 12 docker run -ti --name local-ai -p 8080:8080 --gpus all localai/localai:latest-gpu-nvidia-cuda-12 # NVIDIA Jetson ARM64 (CUDA 12, for AGX Orin and similar) docker run -ti --name local-ai -p 8080:8080 --gpus all localai/localai:latest-nvidia-l4t-arm64 # NVIDIA Jetson ARM64 (CUDA 13, for DGX Spark) docker run -ti --name local-ai -p 8080:8080 --gpus all localai/localai:latest-nvidia-l4t-arm64-cuda-13 # AMD (ROCm) docker run -ti --name local-ai -p 8080:8080 --device=/dev/kfd --device=/dev/dri --group-add=video localai/localai:latest-gpu-hipblas # Intel (oneAPI) docker run -ti --name local-ai -p 8080:8080 --device=/dev/dri/card1 --device=/dev/dri/renderD128 localai/localai:latest-gpu-intel # Vulkan docker run -ti --name local-ai -p 8080:8080 localai/localai:latest-gpu-vulkan ``` LocalAI detects your GPU and downloads the matching backend. See [GPU Acceleration](https://localai.io/docs/models/gpu-acceleration/).
Load a model: ```bash # From the model gallery (list it with `local-ai models list` or at https://models.localai.io) local-ai run qwen3-4b # From Hugging Face local-ai run huggingface://TheBloke/phi-2-GGUF/phi-2.Q8_0.gguf # From the Ollama OCI registry local-ai run ollama://gemma:2b # From a standard OCI registry (for example Docker Hub) local-ai run oci://localai/phi-2:latest ``` To talk to a running server from the terminal, start the built-in agent in another shell. It asks you to approve anything that changes state. See the [Terminal agent](https://localai.io/docs/features/terminal-agent/) docs. ```bash local-ai chat --model qwen3-4b ``` More in the [Quickstart](https://localai.io/docs/start/quickstart/). ## What you can do | Area | What it gives you | |---|---| | [Chats](https://localai.io/docs/features/chats/) | Conversations the server keeps, with saved agents that use tools, [MCP](https://localai.io/docs/features/mcp/), skills and files, triggers, and chat apps | | [Add-ons](https://localai.io/docs/addons/) | Office, Sandbox, Tables, Telegram, Slack, Discord, mail, calendar and more install from a library and run beside the server (development builds) | | [Text generation](https://localai.io/docs/models/capabilities/text/text-generation/) | `llama.cpp`, `transformers`, `vllm` ... [and more](https://localai.io/docs/models/compatibility-table/), with an [OpenAI-compatible tools API](https://localai.io/docs/api/openai-functions/) and [constrained grammars](https://localai.io/docs/models/capabilities/text/constrained_grammars/) | | Speech | [Text to audio](https://localai.io/docs/models/capabilities/audio/text-to-audio/), [audio to text](https://localai.io/docs/models/capabilities/audio/audio-to-text/), voice activity detection (Silero-VAD) and the [Realtime API](https://localai.io/docs/api/openai-realtime/) for speech-to-speech | | Images and vision | [Image generation](https://localai.io/docs/models/capabilities/vision/image-generation/), the [Vision API](https://localai.io/docs/models/capabilities/vision/gpt-vision/) and [object detection](https://localai.io/docs/models/capabilities/vision/object-detection/) | | Search | [Embeddings](https://localai.io/docs/models/capabilities/text/embeddings/) and a [reranker](https://localai.io/docs/models/capabilities/text/reranker/) | | Operations | API key auth, user quotas and roles, [distributed mode](https://localai.io/docs/administration/distributed-mode/) (PostgreSQL + NATS) and [P2P inferencing](https://localai.io/docs/administration/p2p-federated-inference/) | | Models and backends | [Models from Hugging Face](https://localai.io/docs/models/) and a [Backend Gallery](https://localai.io/docs/models/backends/) to install or remove backends on the fly, plus the integrated web UI | LocalAI has more than 80 backends. Hardware acceleration covers NVIDIA (CUDA 12 and 13), AMD (ROCm), Intel (oneAPI/SYCL), Apple Silicon (Metal), Vulkan and NVIDIA Jetson (L4T). See the [Backend and Model Compatibility Table](https://localai.io/docs/models/compatibility-table/). ## Backends we build Most backends wrap a best-in-class upstream engine. A handful of them are native C/C++/GGML engines (no Python at inference) developed and maintained by the LocalAI project itself: | Backend | What it does | |---------|-------------| | [vllm.cpp](https://github.com/mudler/vllm.cpp) | From-scratch C++20 port of vLLM for text generation: paged KV cache, continuous batching, prefix caching, safetensors + GGUF loading, engine-enforced structured output, on CPU, CUDA, Metal and Vulkan. Also serves MiniMax-H3 joint video+audio generation | | [parakeet.cpp](https://github.com/mudler/parakeet.cpp) | C++/GGML port of NVIDIA NeMo Parakeet ASR (tdt/ctc/rnnt/hybrid), with cache-aware streaming transcription | | [moss-transcribe.cpp](https://github.com/localai-org/moss-transcribe.cpp) | C++/GGML port of OpenMOSS MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize: joint long-form transcription, speaker diarization and timestamping in a single pass | | [moss-tts.cpp](https://github.com/mudler/moss-tts.cpp) | C++/GGML port of the OpenMOSS MOSS-TTS family: text-to-speech (MOSS-TTS-Local v1.5, 48 kHz stereo) with reference-audio voice cloning, through the MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer neural codec | | [magpie-tts.cpp](https://github.com/mudler/magpie-tts.cpp) | C++/GGML port of NVIDIA's Magpie TTS Multilingual 357M: 22.05 kHz mono text-to-speech in 5 voices and 9+ languages, with the NanoCodec neural codec and tokenizer/G2P embedded in a single GGUF | | [ced.cpp](https://github.com/localai-org/ced.cpp) | C++/GGML port of the CED audio-tagging models: sound-event classification (527-class AudioSet) over REST and the realtime API for live recognition | | [voice-detect.cpp](https://github.com/localai-org/voice-detect.cpp) | Speaker recognition and voice analysis (ECAPA-TDNN, WeSpeaker, ERes2Net, CAM++, wav2vec2 age/gender/emotion), replacing the Python speaker-recognition backend | | [vibevoice.cpp](https://github.com/mudler/vibevoice.cpp) | Native port of Microsoft VibeVoice for TTS (voice cloning) and long-form ASR with speaker diarization | | [rf-detr.cpp](https://github.com/localai-org/rf-detr.cpp) | Native RF-DETR object detection and instance segmentation | | [locate-anything.cpp](https://github.com/mudler/locate-anything.cpp) | Open-vocabulary object detection and visual grounding (LocateAnything-3B) | | [depth-anything.cpp](https://github.com/mudler/depth-anything.cpp) | Depth Anything 3 monocular metric depth + camera pose estimation | | [face-detect.cpp](https://github.com/mudler/face-detect.cpp) | Face detection, recognition, demographics and anti-spoofing (SCRFD/ArcFace, YuNet/SFace), replacing the Python insightface backend | | [timestral.cpp](https://github.com/mudler/timestral.cpp) | Mistral Timestral time-series forecasting: quantile forecasts with covariates, on the CPU | | [trellis2.cpp](https://github.com/localai-org/trellis2cpp) | C++/GGML port of Microsoft TRELLIS.2: single-image to textured 3D mesh (GLB with PBR materials) | | [gem-x.cpp](https://github.com/localai-org/gem-x.cpp) | Live human motion capture with SOMA and SMPL pose streams (CPU/Vulkan) | | [kimodo.cpp](https://github.com/localai-org/kimodo.cpp) | C++/GGML text-to-motion on CPU and Vulkan, exported as animated skeleton GLB | | [privacy-filter.cpp](https://github.com/localai-org/privacy-filter.cpp) | Standalone GGML PII/NER token-classification engine powering LocalAI's PII redaction tier | | [LocalVQE](https://github.com/localai-org/LocalVQE) | Joint acoustic echo cancellation, noise suppression, and dereverberation | | [local-store](https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI) | Local-first vector database for embeddings (shipped in-tree) | We also maintain [apex-quant](https://github.com/localai-org/apex-quant), a per-tensor, per-layer quantization recipe for Mixture-of-Experts models that exploits their structural sparsity to produce GGUFs matching or beating Q8_0 quality - and they run out of the box on stock llama.cpp. ## Latest news - **October 2026**: **LocalAI 4.12.1** — A security fix for the policy on URLs that users give. Redirect targets are now checked on every hop. [Release notes](https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI/releases/tag/v4.12.1) - **October 2026**: **LocalAI 4.12.0** — A redesigned web UI, streaming voice answers, decision routing with the `/v1/decisions` API, image upscaling in Studio and Qdrant stores. [Release notes](https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI/releases/tag/v4.12.0) - **October 2026**: **LocalAI 4.11.0** — Audio scenes with transcription, speaker labels, and sound detection. Also the Decisions API (`/v1/systemone`), model failover chains, signed OCI galleries, and Kimodo text-to-animation. [Release notes](https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI/releases/tag/v4.11.0) - **September 2026**: **LocalAI 4.10.0** — A fleet operations dashboard, one credentials file for private model sources, and `local-ai benchmark` for measuring model latency and throughput. [Release notes](https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI/releases/tag/v4.10.0) - **August 2026**: **LocalAI 4.9.0** — Deny-by-default authentication, opt-in chat context compression, unified model and backend management, and MiniMax-H3 video generation with audio. [Release notes](https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI/releases/tag/v4.9.0) Older news and the full release notes: [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI/releases) and the [blog](https://localai.io/blog/). ## Resources - [Documentation](https://localai.io/) and the [Quickstart](https://localai.io/docs/start/quickstart/) - [LLM fine-tuning guide](https://localai.io/docs/models/training/fine-tuning/), [build from source](https://localai.io/docs/contributing/build-from-source/) and [Kubernetes installation](https://localai.io/docs/start/install/kubernetes/) - [Integrations and community projects](https://localai.io/docs/api/integrations/) - [Examples](https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI-examples), including the [realtime voice assistant demo](https://github.com/localai-org/localai-realtime-demo) - [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [security policy](SECURITY.md) ## Team LocalAI is maintained by a small team of humans, together with the wider community of contributors. - **[Ettore Di Giacinto](https://github.com/mudler)** — original author and project lead - **[Richard Palethorpe](https://github.com/richiejp)** — maintainer A huge thank you to everyone who contributes code, reviews PRs, files issues, and helps users in [Discord](https://discord.gg/uJAeKSAGDy). See the full [contributors list](https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI/graphs/contributors). ## Sponsors Support the project by becoming [a backer or sponsor](https://github.com/sponsors/mudler). A huge thank you to our sponsors, who cover CI expenses, and to the individual sponsors listed on [GitHub](https://github.com/sponsors/mudler) and [buymeacoffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/mudler). Special shout out to [drikster80](https://github.com/drikster80).
